label: Install row-locked route structure and append-only history guards

precheck.description: ensure these guard functions are not already installed

execute.description: install integrity functions and enabled triggers

postcheck.description: verify all eight integrity/history triggers exist and are enabled
postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 8 AS result FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND tgenabled = 'O' AND tgname IN ('route_no_truncate', 'route_stop_no_truncate', 'route_integrity_guard', 'route_stop_integrity_guard', 'delivery_attempt_append_only', 'delivery_attempt_no_truncate', 'legacy_reconciliation_append_only', 'legacy_reconciliation_no_truncate')
